summary: ansible-core 2.20 adds Python 3.14 support, drops Python 3.11 on the controller and Python 3.8 on targets.
questions: Can I run ansible-core 2.20 on Python 3.11?

answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.20 Python support
answer_card.answer_md:
- Adds support for **Python 3.14**.
- Drops Python **3.11** on the controller.
- Drops Python **3.8** on targets.
